run-integration-tests.name: Run Integration Tests
run-integration-tests.run:
cd ublue/skillet
cargo run --bin skillet -- test run joey --phase base --image fedora:latest

validate-private-ui-caddy-configuration.name: Validate private UI Caddy configuration
validate-private-ui-caddy-configuration.run:
cd ublue/skillet
cargo test -p skillet_caddy generated_identity_caddyfile_validates_with_the_real_consumer -- --ignored
cargo test -p skillet_caddy real_caddy_no_auth_refresh_stays_behind_identity_gate -- --ignored
cargo test -p skillet_caddy real_caddy_authorizes_empty_queries_and_preserves_backend_uri -- --ignored
cargo test -p skillet_caddy real_caddy_homeassistant_navigation_retains_identity_and_origin_guards -- --ignored
cargo test -p skillet_caddy real_caddy_public_native_auth_and_private_denial_share_the_same_listener -- --ignored

build-and-test-the-pinned-jellyfin-cache.name: Build and test the pinned Jellyfin cache image
build-and-test-the-pinned-jellyfin-cache.run:
podman build -t ghcr.io/gbagnoli/skillet-caddy:cache-v1 ublue/skillet/crates/caddy/image
cd ublue/skillet
cargo test -p skillet_caddy real_caddy_static_cache_ -- --ignored

test-gokapi-native-bootstrap-and-paired-.name: Test Gokapi native bootstrap and paired state without external credentials
test-gokapi-native-bootstrap-and-paired-.run:
cd ublue/skillet
cargo test -p skillet_gokapi real_gokapi_ -- --ignored

test-pi-hole-proxy-authentication-withou.name: Test Pi-hole proxy authentication without external credentials
test-pi-hole-proxy-authentication-withou.run:
cd ublue/skillet
cargo test -p skillet_pihole real_pihole_ -- --ignored

test-syncthing-bootstrap-without-externa.name: Test Syncthing bootstrap without external credentials

test-filebrowser-quantum-file-operations.name: Test FileBrowser Quantum file operations without external credentials

test-native-ups-configuration-without-ha.name: Test native UPS configuration without hardware
test-native-ups-configuration-without-ha.run:
cd ublue/skillet
podman build -t localhost/skillet-nut-runtime crates/nut/tests
cargo test -p skillet_nut real_fedora_nut_accepts_config_and_monitors_a_safe_dummy_ups -- --ignored

run-installation-and-bootstrap-regressio.name: Run installation and bootstrap regressions
run-installation-and-bootstrap-regressio.run:
bash ublue/butane/tests/bootstrap.sh
bash ublue/butane/tests/storage-bootstrap.sh
bash ublue/butane/tests/hardware.sh

test-tpm-bootstrap-without-hardware-or-e.name: Test TPM bootstrap without hardware or external credentials
test-tpm-bootstrap-without-hardware-or-e.run:
cd ublue/skillet
cargo test -p skillet_workstation physical_tpm_payload_passes_real_butane_merge -- --ignored
cargo test -p skillet_workstation real_software_tpm_bootstrap_driver -- --ignored
